stories.title: Family Of Anti-ICE Activist Renee Good Sues Trump Officials Over Fatal Minneapolis Shooting
stories.summary: Renee Good’s family has filed two lawsuits against current and former Trump administration officials over her fatal shooting by a federal immigration agent in Minneapolis. The suits allege wrongful killing, excessive force, recklessness and civil-rights violations, while the family’s lawyers say federal officials fostered an environment of state-sponsored violence. Good, a US citizen, was killed during a January confrontation with ICE officers amid a major immigration-enforcement operation.

stories.title: Top secrets come spilling out
stories.summary: A CNN account revisits the 1917 Zimmermann Telegram, a coded German message intercepted and deciphered by British analysts. It proposed unrestricted submarine warfare and sought Mexico’s support against the United States with a promise involving Texas, New Mexico and Arizona. Its publication caused a sensation and helped propel the United States into the First World War against Germany.

links.headline: Top secrets come spilling out
links.excerpt: In 1917, British analysts deciphered a coded message the German foreign minister sent to one of his country's diplomats vowing to begin "unrestricted submarine warfare" and seeking to win over Mexico with a promise to "reconquer the lost territory in Texas, New Mexico and Arizona" if the US entered the world war. When it became public, the Zimmerman Telegram caused a sensation, helping propel the US into the conflict against Germany.

stories.title: Gears of War: E-Day review – an alien invasion shouldn’t be this boring
stories.summary: The Guardian’s review says Gears of War: E-Day delivers the series’ best combat in 20 years but disappoints in the elements surrounding it. The game takes players to Emergence Day, depicting ground tremors, fleeing civilians and alien creatures pouring into the world. Despite that spectacle, the review finds the invasion surprisingly dull overall.

stories.title: AI chatbots remove hijabs from images of Muslim women when prompted
stories.summary: The Guardian found that several AI chatbots would edit photographs to remove Muslim women’s hijabs when prompted. Its tests covered ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini and Claude and followed an incident in which a French far-right politician altered a Muslim woman’s image in that way. The report describes the edits as violating a common and visible expression of faith.
